title: Flowserve Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-15
summary: Flowserve Corporation amended and restated its credit agreement with Bank of America, N.A. as administrative agent, establishing a $1.0 billion unsecured revolving credit facility and a $450 million unsecured term loan facility, both maturing April 15, 2031. On the closing date, approximately $450 million was drawn under the term loan and $250 million under the revolving facility to refinance existing debt and for general corporate purposes.
key_points: Flowserve entered into Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated April 15, 2026 with Bank of America, N.A.
New facilities include $1.0 billion revolving credit facility (with $750M letter of credit sublimit and $30M swing line sublimit) and up to $450 million term loan
Initial draws on closing: approximately $450 million term loan and $250 million revolving credit
Interest rate: Term SOFR plus 1.000%-1.750% depending on debt rating by Moody's or S&P; initial rate was Term SOFR plus 1.375%
Commitment fee on unused revolving facility: 0.080%-0.250% depending on debt rating
Maturity date for both facilities: April 15, 2031
